questions.q: In the scikit-learn inference script, which function is called once when the container starts to load the model?
questions.explain: model_fn(model_dir) loads the model from the model directory when the model server starts. input_fn, predict_fn and output_fn then run for each request.

questions.q: Which boto3 client do applications use to call a deployed endpoint?
questions.explain: The runtime client's invoke_endpoint sends data to an in-service endpoint. The sagemaker client manages the resources but does not serve predictions.

questions.q: What is the role of an endpoint configuration?
options: It lists production variants: which model, instance type and instance count to run
It holds the IAM policy for S3
questions.explain: The endpoint configuration names one or more production variants, each with a model, instance type and count. The endpoint is then created from that configuration.

questions.q: You finish testing and leave a real-time endpoint running over the weekend with no traffic. What happens?
options: SageMaker deletes it automatically after an hour
Its instances keep running and billing until you delete the endpoint
questions.explain: A real-time endpoint's instances run for as long as it exists, regardless of traffic, so delete endpoints you no longer need.

questions.q: What would you use to send 10% of traffic to a candidate model while 90% still goes to the current one?
options: Two production variants with different weights in one endpoint configuration
questions.explain: Production variants carry weights, so one endpoint can split traffic between models, which is how gradual rollouts and A/B tests are done.
